Hours.confirmed: Hours confirmed {days, plural, =0 {today} =1 {yesterday} other {# days ago}} {by, select, clinic {by the clinic} paw_ops {by PAW} other {from a report}}

AdminHours.weeklyHint: Manila time. Add a second interval for a lunch break. A closing time earlier than the opening time runs past midnight into the next day.
AdminHours.is24hHint: While this is on, the weekly hours below are ignored. Exceptions (holidays, closed today) still apply.
AdminHours.noHoursWarning: No weekly hours: owners see “Hours unknown — call ahead”.
AdminHours.unsaved: Unsaved changes. The preview includes them; owners see them only after you save.

issues.empty: Opening and closing times are the same. For a branch that never closes, use “Open 24 hours”.
issues.overlap: Overlaps another interval. One that closes after midnight runs into the next morning.

AdminHours.exceptionsHint: Holidays and special days. They replace that date's weekly hours, even for a 24-hour branch. Past dates are kept as history.
AdminHours.replacesExisting: This date already has an exception. Saving replaces it.
AdminHours.closedTodayHint: For sudden closures: the vet is sick, a power outage. Owners see “Closed today” with your note until midnight.
AdminHours.previewHint: What owners see at the chosen time.
AdminHours.confirmHint: Press after checking with the clinic that these hours are still right.

AdminServices.speciesHint: Shown on the clinic page, and used by the species filter in search.
AdminServices.noSpeciesWarning: No species yet: owners filtering by species won't find this branch.
AdminServices.servicesHint: Prices are estimates; the clinic page says so. Owners see “₱500–₱800”, “From ₱500” or “Call for price”.
AdminServices.name: Name shown to owners
AdminServices.nameHint: e.g. “Kapon (cat)” or “Anti-rabies vaccine”. Starts as the service type.
AdminServices.speciesServiceHint: The animals this service is for. Starts as the species the branch treats.
AdminServices.noSpeciesYet: Set the species this branch treats first (above).
AdminServices.priceHint: Both: a range. Only the lowest: “From ₱…”. Neither: “Call for price”.
AdminServices.priceInvalid: Enter an amount in pesos, e.g. 1,500 or 1500.50.
AdminServices.copyNothing: Every other branch already has this service with the same details and species.

AdminProducts.title: Products
AdminProducts.hint: Shown read-only on the business page: name, price and availability. No stock counts.
AdminProducts.name: Name
AdminProducts.priceHint: Leave empty to show “Ask for price”.
AdminProducts.priceInvalid: Enter an amount in pesos, e.g. 450 or 1,299.50.

AdminPhotos.title: Photos
AdminPhotos.hint: Shown on the clinic page in this order; the first one is the main photo.
AdminPhotos.full: This branch has the most photos allowed. Delete one to add another.
AdminPhotos.storageOff: Photo storage isn't set up yet. Add the R2_* variables to the API (see apps/api/.env.example) and restart it.
AdminPhotos.chooseHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. It's resized before uploading (up to {size} pixels on the longest side).
AdminPhotos.altHint: Read aloud to people who can't see it, e.g. “Front of the clinic with the blue sign”.
AdminPhotos.unreadable: Couldn't read this image. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP (export iPhone HEIC photos as JPG first).
AdminPhotos.tooBig: This image is still over 2 MB after resizing. Try a smaller one.
AdminPhotos.uploadFailed: The upload didn't go through. Check your connection, and that the bucket's CORS rule allows this site.
AdminPhotos.reorderFailed: Couldn't reorder. Reload the page and try again.
AdminPhotos.logoHint: Square works best. Shown next to the business name.

AdminListings.title: Listings
AdminListings.results: {total, plural, =0 {No businesses} one {# business} other {# businesses}}

AdminBusiness.noBranches: No branches yet. A business needs at least one branch (with an address and map pin) to appear on PAW.

AdminForms.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields, then save again.
AdminForms.name: Name
AdminForms.slugHint: Used in the page address. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Changing it later breaks old links.
AdminForms.dataSourceHint: Where this information came from, e.g. "Clinic visit, Nov 2026" or "Facebook page".
AdminForms.businessListingHint: New businesses start hidden. Publish once a branch has an address, pin and contacts.
AdminForms.addressLineHint: Street, building, landmark. The barangay and city come from the pickers below.
AdminForms.areasFailed: Couldn't load the list. Pick again to retry.
AdminForms.locationHint: Click the map to drop the pin, then drag it to the exact spot. Or paste coordinates from Google Maps (right-click the place → click the numbers to copy them).
AdminForms.coordinatesInvalid: Paste two numbers, latitude first, e.g. 15.1450, 120.5887.
AdminForms.coordinatesOutside: That's outside the Philippines. Check that latitude comes first.
AdminForms.pinMissing: Drop a pin on the map or paste coordinates.
AdminForms.mapLabel: Map for placing the branch pin
AdminForms.mapFailed: The map couldn't load. Paste coordinates instead.
AdminForms.branchListingHint: Hide or close one branch without touching the rest of the business.
AdminForms.contactsHint: Phone numbers can be typed as clinics write them (0917 123 4567, (045) 888 1234). They're saved in international format.

Login.subtitle: For the PAW team. Clinic accounts are coming soon.
Login.noAccess: This Google account doesn't have access to PAW admin. Sign in with a different account.
